label: PF Backlog 217
title: Backend: sensor/IoT capability pack + ingest adapters (MQTT/serial/BLE/Modbus/CAN) + time-series/anomaly models
body:
## Problem / why
IoT/sensor products are a listed modality but have no pack, no ingest, no store, and no time-series
models -- so they cannot be built. Sensors are data STREAMS, not media files.

## Goal & value
A `sensor` capability pack that, only when the idea needs it, enables device ingest, a time-series
store, forecasting/anomaly models, and a sensor-analyst agent -- all with permissive tooling.

## In scope
- **Ingest adapters:** MQTT (`paho-mqtt`), serial (`pyserial`), BLE (`bleak`), Modbus
  (`pymodbus`/`minimalmodbus`), CAN (`python-can`, LGPL), HTTP/REST, CSV/Parquet backfill.
- **Store:** Parquet/InfluxDB (client MIT) time-series store; register in store-registry.json.
  Grafana stays EXTERNAL (AGPL, never embedded).
- **Models (open-weights, permissive):** anomaly (IsolationForest, autoencoder/TSB-AE),
  forecasting (DLinear, N-BEATS, PatchTST, TimesNet, Chronos, Moirai); TinyML export (TFLite Micro).
- **Kinds:** `timeseries` (forecast), `sensor` (anomaly/classify); **fusion** (sensor+vision) as stretch.
- **Agent:** `sensor-analyst` (+ knowledge/skills), gated by the pack; capability pack entries in
  config/capability-packs.json.
- **QA:** range/rate checks, gap detection, drift alerts.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- An IoT idea enables the sensor pack (ingest+models+agent active); a plain app enables none.
- End-to-end: replay a CSV stream -> anomaly flagged + forecast produced as artifacts.
- All bundled tools/models are permissive (no GPL/AGPL embedded).

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: ingest adapter contract with a fake broker; model wrapper on a fixture series.
- Integration: CSV replay -> anomaly + forecast artifact; wired_audit green.
